pages.text: $(bold)No minimap.$() The atlas is the map.$(br)$(bold)No fast travel.$() Rails, ships, wagons and roads.$(br)$(bold)No trading halls.$() Villagers trade well where they live well.$(br)$(bold)No block griefing from cannons.$() They hurt mobs and players; the land stays.$(br2)$(bold)No thirst.$() The seasons and the cold are the survival layer: what grows when, and a fire for winter nights.

$(bold)Sleep is a vote:$() when half the players online are in bed, the night skips; the action bar counts who is sleeping.$(br2)$(bold)Tab$() shows the server's TPS and everyone's ping. Twenty is healthy; if it sits below fifteen while nobody is doing anything unusual, tell the admin what everyone was doing.

$(bold)Towns are capped$() at about two dozen villagers; breeding stops when a town is full. Found another.$(br)$(bold)Depots need towns:$() a bell and four beds within 32 blocks.$(br)$(bold)Technology is personal:$() your Blueprints are yours. Trade them.$(br2)Everything on this page is enforced by the pack, not by trust. The admin can switch any of it in $(bold)kubejs/config/peacock.json$().
